questions.text: Which Italian artist painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel?
questions.explanation: Michelangelo painted the ceiling between 1508 and 1512.

questions.text: The Bastille, stormed in 1789, stood in which city?
questions.explanation: The storming of the Bastille in Paris began the French Revolution.

questions.text: Which Italian city is considered the birthplace of the Renaissance?
Which general commanded the Continental Army in the American Revolution and later became the first US president?
questions.explanation: Washington led the Continental Army and was elected president in 1789.

questions.text: Which 1776 document declared the thirteen colonies independent from Britain?
questions.explanation: The Declaration of Independence was adopted on 4 July 1776.

questions.text: Who introduced movable-type printing to Europe in the 15th century?
questions.explanation: Gutenberg's press in Mainz produced the Bible around 1455.

questions.text: Who led the Bolsheviks in the October Revolution of 1917?
questions.explanation: Lenin was the leader of the Bolshevik party.

questions.text: Which Florentine banking family were leading patrons of Renaissance art?
questions.explanation: The Medici funded artists such as Botticelli and Michelangelo.

questions.text: Which French king was executed in 1793?
questions.explanation: Louis XVI was guillotined in January 1793.

questions.text: Which Polish astronomer proposed a Sun-centred model of the universe in 1543?
Who wrote "The Prince", a political treatise published in 1532?
questions.explanation: Machiavelli wrote it around 1513; it was published after his death.

questions.text: Which South American liberator was known as "El Libertador"?
questions.explanation: Bolivar helped free Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Bolivia.

questions.text: Which Dutch scholar wrote "In Praise of Folly" in 1511?
questions.explanation: Desiderius Erasmus wrote it while staying with Thomas More.

questions.text: Which priest issued the 1810 "Grito de Dolores" that began Mexico's war of independence?
questions.explanation: Hidalgo's call to arms in Dolores launched the independence struggle.

questions.text: Which 1494 treaty divided newly discovered lands between Spain and Portugal?
questions.explanation: Tordesillas set a line of demarcation west of the Cape Verde islands.

spares.text: Which country's revolution of 1789 popularised the tricolour flag?
spares.explanation: The French tricolour became the symbol of the Revolution.

spares.text: Which Spanish conquistador conquered the Aztec Empire?
Which 1688 event replaced James II with William and Mary?
spares.explanation: The Glorious Revolution was largely bloodless in England.
